notes.title: Quality Update for Gogte
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It has been optimized:
* Textures, improve loading speed.
* Lights are now faster in rendering.
* Fixed destructible objects.

Event 23:
* Descriptive messages have been placed to give clues and their translation.

For anything or error, I'll wait for you in the forum.
Greetings.
Oso

notes.title: Update for the Festival of Fear: The Revenge
notes.content:
Hello everyone, What does the update include? Well, here's the following list:

* Change of game engine. We're still using DirectX 11. DirectX 12 is up for discussion. It may bring new bugs that weren't there before...

* Change of intro logo.

* Use of DSLL, whether you use Nvidia or not. Subject to debate. Personally, I prefer AMD FR 2.

* Chapter selection.

* And finally, the highly anticipated Halloween event. Last year, we went for a "skeletal pumpkin shooter," what will it be this year, hahaha. Personally, I find it satisfying when you know what to do. I'll leave it open for discussion.

All discussions can be found in the community thread. 

Thank you very much, you're awesome. 
Greetings. 
Oso

notes.title: Version 0.9 Update Notes
notes.content:
Here we detail the main changes:
* New map: to celebrate halloween in a big way. There is a new option in the main menu.
* Minor correction of shadows, objects and textures.

* New Enemies: 4 new deadly AI profiles have been created for experienced players. You will see the enemies placed on the event map.

Thank you all for your comments. Happy Halloween.

notes.title: Gogte Update 0.6
notes.content:
Here is the update list:

[list]
[*] New full map.
[*] Added a tutorial room explaining how the gun works.
[*] Changed action pointers for better visibility at high resolutions.
[*] Implemented passive regeneration: 10 points per minute. Life is now displayed in units.
[*] Autosaves between maps have been implemented, to help see new content to come sooner.
[*] Miscellaneous texture, performance, and sound fixes.
[/list]

All feedback received is appreciated. Thank you very much.
Oso.

notes.title: Update 0.5
notes.content:
Following fixes/changes:
- Texture of the control page in English and Spanish/Latin
- Added names of locations on maps. Useful for reporting bugs, making guides, etc.
- Added a cursor software.
- Fixed note 1 event on the forest map.
- Added water physics in Bosque de Pilares.
- Redesigned a new enemy to be more scary ;)
- The lights have been changed to volumetric, on the second level.
- Added a save point next to the gun.
- Fixed minor bugs.

Level 1 is now complete.
Thank you for your comments, we continue working for more content in the next version.
Oso.

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.content:
Below is the list of the [b]update[/b]:
[list]
[*] - Correction in textures, map and lighting.
[*] - Point of light at the beginning of map 2.
[*] - new mechanic: hidden messages, visible with the flashlight when using the Z key. Put hidden clues to facilitate progression.
[*] - new mechanic: message translation, when we look at old letters for 2 seconds, their translation will be displayed for 10 seconds. Hidden messages are translated automatically. Those blood messages...
[*] - Added Latin language.
[*] - Added a basic level loader.
[/list]

[b]Thank you for the Comments and Reviews[/b] published, we take you into account and give us the necessary feedback to continue improving.
Bear.
